narrative.overview: A descriptive current-state system that places varied game campaigns inside a stable blue corporate shell, balancing promotional energy with regulated trust.
keyCharacteristics: Ubuntu headings with Proxima Nova body copy
Mixed compact and pill radius vocabulary
Repeated community, support, and responsible-play frame

rules.name: The Blue Anchor Rule
rules.body: Use the recurring blue family to anchor the corporate shell.

dos: Do preserve the blue corporate shell around visually varied game campaigns.
Do keep responsible-play, support, legal, and community-return pathways visible.
donts: Don't treat campaign-specific gradients as universal brand colors.
Don't imply a single radius or modular type scale where the source CSS shows variance.
